strategy.decoding: HTML entities, JS Unicode escapes, surrogate pairs, hex escapes, CSS Unicode escapes. No normalization of Japanese variants.
strategy.editorial: Explicit bounded source list for generated work/city/event text; no recursive QA/docs/archive scan.
strategy.html: Every .html not excluded by current .vercelignore; decoded text nodes and display/accessibility attributes; inline scripts/style and data-* attributes are a conservative superset.
strategy.limits: Arbitrary user-entered notes, third-party responses and future text are not enumerable; system fallback remains necessary. External fonts/content are not fetched.
strategy.reserve: Printable ASCII plus upstream-supported hiragana, katakana and halfwidth kana.
strategy.runtime: Transitively linked same-origin JS/JSON/GeoJSON/CSS, plus document-relative referenced data; full decoded source is a conservative superset including choices, errors, comments and identifiers.
